title: OPEN GYM AND RECOVERY
content: The Commons holds an open session for anyone who wants to train. Experienced students help newcomers set up safely, and the recovery wing stays busy with stretching and quiet conversation. The strongest presence in the room is not a contest; it is the ease of people who know one another.
